purpose: Quarantine the newest orthogonal discovery issues as machine-checkable hypotheses so they enter deterministic source/PIT feasibility without bypassing governance.

candidates.name: SEC filing-arrival clock × residual-momentum state
candidates.hypothesis: A newly public SEC filing may change the interpretation of a pre-existing residual-momentum state because the filing changes the information set.
candidates.construction: Use EDGAR acceptance timestamp, filing form, accession/amendment identity and a previously frozen residual state; align only to a subsequent eligible XNYS session.
candidates.next_gate: reuse frozen SEC acceptance-time compiler plus deterministic residual-state contract and PIT mutation tests

candidates.name: Reg SHO short-pressure × liquidity state
candidates.hypothesis: Abnormal public short-sale participation may transmit differently under deep versus impaired underlying liquidity.
candidates.construction: Combine daily FINRA Reg SHO short-sale volume with fixed liquidity descriptors under an ex-ante state interaction; preserve publication timing and security identity.
sources: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume
candidates.next_gate: FINRA historical/publication feasibility plus deterministic short-pressure/liquidity compiler and PIT tests

candidates.name: Options order imbalance × underlying liquidity
candidates.hypothesis: Observable options order-flow imbalance may contain information about next-day underlying returns conditional on stock liquidity.
candidates.construction: Use a frozen signed-options-flow definition, underlying liquidity descriptors and a fixed close-to-next-session mapping; reject any source requiring paid historical data.
candidates.next_gate: free historical options-flow source feasibility, timestamp/contract identity audit and deterministic interaction contract

candidates.name: Gamma concentration regime with measurement uncertainty
candidates.hypothesis: Observable gamma magnitude/concentration around nearby strikes may describe a market state without assuming an unobserved dealer-gamma sign.
candidates.construction: Use a frozen, deterministic option-chain-derived gamma magnitude/concentration definition with explicit measurement uncertainty; do not encode long-gamma/short-gamma direction as observed.
candidates.next_gate: free historical options-chain coverage, contract mapping, unit-scaling and sign-identification feasibility

candidates.name: Information-arrival × attention-to-trading-response lag
candidates.hypothesis: The lag from public information arrival to attention/adoption to trading response may define a distinct state from filing arrival alone.
candidates.construction: Anchor information arrival to SEC acceptance time and combine it with a frozen reproducible historical attention proxy plus deterministic response/liquidity state.
candidates.next_gate: historical attention publication/revision audit plus deterministic cross-clock PIT contract

candidates.name: Information complexity × turnover state
candidates.hypothesis: Disclosure complexity may change the sign and strength of short-horizon continuation versus reversal conditional on trading activity.
candidates.construction: Combine a deterministic public-disclosure-complexity state with turnover and isolate the interaction from previously frozen price-only inputs.
candidates.next_gate: deterministic disclosure-complexity definition, historical PIT feasibility and interaction mutation tests

candidates.name: Asymmetric idiosyncratic reversal × systematic/public-information state
candidates.hypothesis: Firm-specific residual shocks may exhibit asymmetric short-horizon reversal while systematic/public-information components behave differently.
candidates.construction: Use a fixed ex-ante systematic component and orthogonal residual decomposition; test asymmetric residual-state transmission without fitted asset/threshold/horizon search.
candidates.next_gate: fixed decomposition contract, leakage mutation tests and symbol-disjoint feasibility

notes: These are discovery hypotheses only; external literature is inspiration, not project evidence.
No candidate is ranked or selected by this inventory.
Each candidate must pass deterministic source/PIT feasibility before any downstream formalization.
Options candidates are explicitly blocked from progression if a free reproducible historical source cannot be established.
